findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tempo_wallet, tempo_peg, geo_search, tech_detect, email_verify, attest_session, attest_verify · Private data: tempo_tx, tempo_wallet, qr_png, dns_lookup, email_verify, ip_lookup, attest_session · Public sink: tempo_gas, tempo_tx, tempo_wallet, tempo_peg, qr_png, qr_svg, qr_scan, geo_search, geo_reverse, geo_timezone, tech_detect, math_eval, math_convert, math_symbolic, dns_lookup, email_verify, ip_lookup, attest_session, attest_verify, ipinfo_ip_lite, ipinfo_ip_lookup · Destructive: qr_png, qr_scan, math_eval, ipinfo_ip_lite, ipinfo_ip_lookup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tempo_wallet, tempo_peg, geo_search, tech_detect, email_verify, attest_session, attest_verify · Private data: tempo_tx, tempo_wallet, qr_png, dns_lookup, email_verify, ip_lookup, attest_session · Public sink: tempo_gas, tempo_tx, tempo_wallet, tempo_peg, qr_png, qr_svg, qr_scan, geo_search, geo_reverse, geo_timezone, tech_detect, math_eval, math_convert, math_symbolic, dns_lookup, email_verify, ip_lookup, attest_session, attest_verify, ipinfo_ip_lite, ipinfo_ip_lookup · Destructive: qr_png, qr_scan, math_eval, ipinfo_ip_lite, ipinfo_ip_lookup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
